title: Mack Titan Custom Built FUPS Road Train Bullbar with extended backing plate #11
description: Mack Titan hi-tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar. 100mm dia pipe and 100mm wide heavy duty box uprights fitted with hinged heavy-duty mesh between centre uprights. Cowcatcher and 4 gussets. Indicator/Daylight running lights in outer heavy duty box uprights. Stick on Road Train signs with silver covers, choice of cover colours. Driving light mounts as requested, heavy duty tow pin mounted through heavy duty steel backing plate with chrome tow hitch cover and 4 eye bolts on an extended backing plate. Custom built bull bars as required
